newsitem.title: USA: Digital seeks AMEX listing for new warants.
newsitem.headline: Digital seeks AMEX listing for new warants.

text.p: Digital Communications Technology Corp said Monday it plans to issue Class A and Class B Warrants as a dividend to its shareholders. Shareholders of record, April 30, will receive one Class A Warrant for each seven shares of common stock held, and one Class B Warrant for every four shares of common stock held. The company said
it had 7,314,922 shares of common stock issued and outstanding as of March 28.

Each Class A Warrant entitles the registered holder to purchase one share of common stock at the exercise price of $3.50, subject to certain adjustments, for a period of two years after the effective date of the registration statement. Each Class B Warrant entitles the registered holder to purchase one share of common stock at the exercise price of $5.00, subject to certain adjustments, for a period of three years after the effective date of the registration statement.
The company said it will file an application to have the Class A and Class B Warrants admitted for trading on the American Stock Exchange.
